title: File:Sailors fire Phalanx close-in weapons system 140905-N-GW918-004.jpg
description:
Guided-missile cruiser USS Bunker Hill (CG 52) fires test rounds from the Phalanx close-in weapons system. Bunker Hill is underway in the 7th Fleet area of responsibility as part of the Carl Vinson Carrier Strike Group supporting security and stability in the Indo-Asia-Pacific region. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class LaTunya Howard/Released)
